summary: ORIX Corporation files a Form 6-K with several items including 'Announcement Regarding Changes in Representative Executive Officer' and 'Announcement Regarding Management Changes and Organizational Reform' (Items 2 and 3). The report also includes the approved version of Articles of Incorporation from the 63rd Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. Although no forced departure is specified, the naming of management changes as a discrete item indicates an event of significance. Investors should watch for details on successor appointments and strategic implications of the organizational reform.
